title: certified-orbits
description:
This repository will attempt computer-assisted proofs, using interval arithmetic, that published numerical periodic orbits of the three-body problem exist, and that some listed as linearly stable are linearly stable.

Status: not started. No proofs or certificates are present yet.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
